title: wslua: Expose attributes and iteration for debugger introspection
description:
Surface class metadata and iteration so the Lua debugger's Variables
view drills into userdata as structured rows instead of opaque leaves.

Read-only attributes added:
  Pref            name, label, description, type, type_name, value
  ProtoExpert     abbrev, text, group, severity
  Tvb             captured_length, reported_length, raw_offset
  TvbRange        length, position
  ByteArray       length
  DissectorTable  name, ui_name, type, type_name
  Address         type, type_name, length
  PseudoHeader    type, type_name
  Dumper          is_open, file_type{,_name,_description},
                  encap{,_name,_description}
  Dissector       description, protocol_short_name

__pairs metamethods added for Prefs, Columns, PrivateTable and
PseudoHeader. Column is now a non-expandable leaf whose __tostring
returns its current text. Dumper getters are safe on closed handles
(return nil). DissectorTable's dead fallback is now
ws_assert_not_reached.

New WSLUA_STATELESS_PAIRS_BODY(C) macro deduplicates the __pairs
wrapper shared by Columns, Prefs and PseudoHeader.

Ping #21193

AI-Assisted: yes

+/* Body of a __pairs metamethod that hands the generic-for protocol
+ * a stateless iterator `C##_pairs_iter`. The iterator must accept
+ * (self, prev_key_or_nil) and return the next (key, value) pair or a
+ * single nil when done. Use inside a WSLUA_METAMETHOD body so the
+ * caller retains control of any doc comments shown in the manual. */
+#define WSLUA_STATELESS_PAIRS_BODY(C)                 \
+    check##C(L, 1);                                   \
+    lua_pushcfunction(L, C##_pairs_iter);             \
+    lua_pushvalue(L, 1);                              \
+    lua_pushnil(L);                                   \
+    return 3
